1) Data mining techniques are able to classify emotional responses by HRV analysis; 2) the model obtained is reliable, stable and applicable to unconscious patients; 3) HRV analysis is a promising tool to investigate possible emotional processing also in unconscious patients; 4) the model is a promising tool for the assessment and monitoring of emotional processing in unconscious patients.
“A reliable classification of emotions by Data Mining analysis is feasible and can be used in patients with disorganized brain functions.”

the application of Data Mining to HRV data in order to forecast the emotional response.
the development of a new methodology for investigating the functional relationships between the HRV and emotional processing in healthy subjects and in patients with disorded consciousness.

a Data Mining approach to the functional relationship between HRV and emotional processing, with the aim to develop an objective method to investigate the emotional response in brain-injured and unconscious patients.
